rationale: The previous candidate reduced kp to 0.45 and kept ki at 0.02, but evaluator feedback suggested that kp might be too low, reducing responsiveness, and ki might be too low to correct steady-state errors effectively. To address this, I increased kp slightly to 0.5 to regain some responsiveness while maintaining kd at 0.22 for damping. I also increased ki to 0.03 to improve steady-state error correction without risking integral windup. Base_speed remains at 0.75 and line_loss strategy at 'search_left' as these balance speed, stability, and recovery well. Sensor weights remain at [-0.4, 0.5, -0.4] to maintain effective line tracking without excessive overcorrection. I expect these changes to reduce steering oscillations, improve line tracking responsiveness, and reduce steady-state error. I request telemetry on steering_oscillation, line_loss_events, completion, progress, completion_time, and rms_error to verify these hypotheses and guide further tuning.
